articleTitle: Microwave device for heat treatment dielectric rods
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The present paper deals with MW device intended for the uniform heating of dielectric rods possessing low heat conductivity via their cross-section. The two sections positioned one after another, with different distribution functions of temperature field and temperature gradient along the radius (circular waveguide and diaphragmatic waveguide) serve as the electrodynamic device. The discrepancy between of the temperature field via cross-section of the dielectric rod did not exceed 10%.

articleTitle: Permalloy films on patterned silicon substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper we study effect of patterning for ferromagnetic films in the case of deposition of continuous films on pre-patterned substrates. Striped structures with the different profile depth were fabricated using photolithography, ion etching and magnetron sputtering. Magnetic force microscopy (MFM), vibrating sample magnetometry (VSM) and ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) were applied to characterize the structures. Obtained results show that such patterned ferromagnetic structures can be interesting in a sense of application in planar microwave devices based on ferromagnetic films (such as notch filters, for example) for busting operational frequency in the case when magnetic filling factor (amount of the magnetic material interacting with microwaves) is important.

articleTitle: Computational modeling of operating conditions of powerful multibeam monotron with four-gap resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The main goal of this publication is computational modeling of operating conditions and determination of optimal parameters for four-gap resonator with cophased oscillation mode that provides maximum value of electronic efficiency for multibeam monotron. A monotron generator that has multibeam structure and common four-gap resonator be able to provide high efficiency and output power, small overall dimensions and weight.

articleTitle: The method and program of processing the measurement results of a dielectric constant and tangent of dielectric loss angle of BeO rods on the personal computer
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The method and program of processing the measurement results of a dielectric constant and tangent of dielectric loss angle of BeO rods on the personal computer is described. The measurement results for different batches of rods are presented. It is shown, that at the frequencies of 3 GHz and 10 GHz dielectric constant epsiv (average on a batch of 50 rods) is 6.7...6.8. The correlation between the measuring data of epsiv from a rod to a rod at these frequencies is present in an explicit form that indicates a relative precision of the performed measurements. The correlation between the change of a dielectric constant and tangent of dielectric loss angle from a rod to a rod was not revealed.

articleTitle: Balance of charge particles of diffusion plasma in transversal magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analytic calculation of distribution of charge particles concentration in diffusion gas discharged plasma of a positive column in a transverse magnetic field has been derived. Boundary conditions taking into account volume charge influence of magnetic field close to dielectric walls have been derived.

articleTitle: Numerical modelling of a coupled cavity travelling wave tube based on non-stationary discrwete theory
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: We present the results of numerical modeling of a coupled cavity traveling wave tube (TWT) amplifier based on the non-stationary discrete theory of excitation of a periodic waveguide. The code developed is applicable for solution of various practical problems, including simulation of amplification of multi-frequency signals, self-modulation and chaos generation, parasitic self-excitation of amplifiers, and short pulses amplification or generation.

The common procedure of the functionals minimization and usages of their stationary properties makes the given approach especially effective as the computation. The given approach can be used also for the acoustoelectronics devices synthesis and optimization.

articleTitle: H- modes of rectangular dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The rectangular dielectric waveguides (RDWs) have been considered and investigated for various practical applications in the series of works. They have been used as probes, in the structures of filters and planar integrated circuits, as elements of resonators, for measurements of dielectric material properties, and for other purpose. Different approximate and rigorous approaches have been applied to analyze the RDW and its discontinuities. There are: the decomposition on the cylindrical harmonics, the Marcatilipsilas approach, the transverse resonance method, the generalized telegraph equation method, the finite difference method, the mode matching method, the integral equation method and the variation approac. For numerical investigations of these approaches several numerical algorithms have been applied: the moment method, the Bubnov-Galerkin method, the collocations, the finite elements, the finite differences and some others. The dimensions of such approaches are very high when good accuracy is need. Therefore the precise determination of RDW mode parameters is actual. In this paper we introduce the simple relations and effective algorithm for accurate determinations of eigenmodes (eigenwaves) and complex H-waves for RDW. The approach is based on two-dimensional hyper-singular integral equation and iteration procedure for its solution which allow one to determine the mode parameters with very high accuracy and small computing resources. Instead of usually used infinite-dimensional functional banach spaces we seek the solution in the two-dimensional Euclidean numeric space with analytical field presentation.

articleTitle: Application of combined multiport reflectometer to microwave diversity imaging

abstract: Conventionally, the object scattered field for microwave diversity imaging is measured directly using a VNA. publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Self-modulation instability is typical for special distributed oscillators especially with time delayed feedback. This instability results in generation of multiple frequencies or even spread spectrum chaotic signal. Numerical results for delayed feedback klystron and traveling-wave tube oscillators are presented showing that application of the method allows stabilization of unstable single frequency regimes and improves performance of the oscillators.

publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of radiation resistance design of magnetostatic forward volume wave multistrip transducer are presented in this report. It was analysed the radiation resistance as a function of frequency for multistrip lines with different number strips and distance between the line conductors and the surface of magnetized ferrite film.

articleTitle: Estimation of temperature stability of an integrated PPM focusing system with samarium-cobalt magnets taking into account nonlinear behavior of steel pole pieces
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A method of estimation of temperature stability of integrated periodical permanent-magnet focusing system with samarium-cobalt magnets is presented. Nonlinear magnetic characteristic of steel is accounted for. MAXWELL SV software has been used to simulate magnetic field of the systems. To give advices for PPM design.

articleTitle: Comparison of different methods of suppression of self-excitation broadband twt on a backward wave in view of a beam expansion at the expense of a dynamic defocusing
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The comparative efficiency of different methods of TWT self-excitation suppression on a backward wave in a dynamic mode is investigated in view of expansion of a beam. The suppression of oscillation on a backward wave by spring of a step of a slow-wave structure (SWS) in devices with a normal dispersion (ND) along the whole length, by jump of a step and slope of a dispersion in devices with an abnormal dispersion (AD) in output section, and also by a jump of a drift channel diameter and a jump of a phase in both types of devices is explored. It is shown, how many a start current of self- excitation on a backward wave varies at usage in them of different methods of its suppression in these devices.

articleTitle: Calculation of a bipolar transistor phase characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Calculation method of a bipolar transistor phase characteristics, where transistor operates at current cutoff regime with closed collector transition, is considered. Notion of transistor as an active quadripole with using piecewise quasi-linear model of this device is underlay of this method.

articleTitle: The electric fields’ investigation of electron bunches in trystron
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analytical relations have been received and calculations for electric fields of a spatial charge of electron bunch in trystron have been made.

articleTitle: Microstrip frequent-selective devices on sections of periodic metal-dielectrical structures investigation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The investigation of microstrip frequent-selective devices on sections of periodic metal-dielectrical structures, are considered. The example of band-pass and low-pass filters designing with the help of AWR design environment (microwave office v.6.53) is shown.

articleTitle: Discrete method simulation of sectioned TWT with non-regular slow wave structures with normal dispersion
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The six-pole network with maximum degrees of freedom that simulate the slow wave structure with normal dispersion has been synthesized. The discrete method of simulation based on a modified code DEV 5.0 has been applied for the simulation of the powerful sectioned TWT with non-regular ring-bar slow wave structure including real matching, local and selective absorbers.

articleTitle: Analysis of the microwave resonance gyroscope with an active ring vibrator
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A constructive solution is suggested and the possibilities are regarded concerning the realization of the microwave resonator gyroscope with an active ring vibrator on different types of transmission lines. The conditions of self-excitation of the active resonator are presented. There have been calculated the general parameters of the microwave gyroscope made on the basis of the microstrip line, the rectangular cross-section waveguide and the dielectric waveguide.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of oscillator on double-gap cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Optimal calculations of regimes and interaction region’s size of self-oscillator on one resonator with antiphase wave mode have been made for six band. The availability of electronic efficiency 53% for the first zone and 54% for the second is shown.

articleTitle: A study of perturbations in electron beam under the action of control grids with a ring and radial ribs
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Using three-dimensional codes the perturbations in electron beam under the action of control grids with a ring and radial ribs are studied. The volt-ampere dependencies, angle distributions of electron trajectories in azimuth and radial directions outside the grid and cut-off potential values for two types of grids are considered.

articleTitle: Computation of fields and parameters of cellular hansets
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Fields and parameters evaluation of modern telecommunication devices is a rather complicated problem because such devices have a large number of dielectric and conducting details often separated by small gaps. Dimensions of the most parts of the device often are less than one thousands of wavelength. These objectives make difficult or even impossible generation of finite element mesh. In this report an algorithm and computer code for field and parameters computation of real life mobile handset CAD models are described. The algorithm is based on vector finite element method in frequency domain. Presented simulation results agree quite satisfactory with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Calculation of the attenuation value of electromagnetic wave for helix break off in helix SWS
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper is described the method of calculation of the attenuation value of electromagnetic wave for helix break off in helix SWS by means of 3-D electromagnetic computer code.

articleTitle: Structured analysis the systems of artificial perception in test technology on base of combinatorial laws
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article the possibility for generate test structures more law order on base the complex test composition matrix type by means combinatorial laws is considered. The main formulas for calculation and structured analysis the test tasks are investigated. For example, the test composition LtLRW, LIW -O or -M type in generator or amplifier modeGt generate test tasks dichotomist type by means combinatorial laws is conduct.

articleTitle: The application of electronic scanning for the express-analysis of blood-smear probability characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: New methods of application of electronic scanning with the successive signal digital processing for the express-analysis of blood smear probability characteristics are suggested and tested experimentally.

articleTitle: The analysis of virtual cathode formation under axisymmerical electron beam slowing
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The dynamics of virtual cathode formation under electron beam slowing in tunnel is researched. Calculations were carried out as for monovelocity nonmodulate in density electron beam as for beam with velocity and density modulation. The differences in form and density of elector pitch in virtual cathode area for both considered beams are shown.

articleTitle: Deriving of the dispersion equation for waveguide with two dielectric plates
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The algorithm of dispersion equation deriving for waveguide with two dielectric plates is given. Such waveguides may be used in two-positional phase shifters.

articleTitle: In matrix form presentation of the expert compositions for systems objects signs in the conditions of increase of both great numbers
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analysis of expert compositions for the systems objects signs in the conditions of increase of the both great numbers, presented in a matrix form as a result of calculation of the computer program, using new approach of the combinatorial calculus of decomposition and visualization on probabilistic structures and substructures, where every element in decomposition characterizes the certain structure of test task, as correlations of signs of the probed objects, possessing the set semantics, and numerical coefficients before elements reflect quantitative descriptions of such structures.

articleTitle: Vacuum circuit breakers: (Features of physics and production technologies)
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Application fields of vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs) are outlined. The physics of the underlying phenomena is considered complicated due to specific behavior of plasma are in alternating magnetic and electric fields. The switching capacity is indicated to be affected by the erosion of electrodes, cracks and pores wearing the surface down, etc. It is observed that VCBs and high-power microwave devices share common behavioral features, some design solutions and technologies. Future trends of VCB development are highlighted.

articleTitle: The Ka - range powerful TWT
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The developmentpsilas results of the TWT with the low-voltage gridless and the high electronic efficiency, the gain coefficient and a broad band amplified frequency are submitted.

articleTitle: Principles of creation of ultra-wideband systems for transmission on the base of ultrashort radiopulses
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Principles of creation of ultra- wideband systems for transmission information on the base of ultrashort radiopulses. Questions of energetic characteristics and scheme realization are investigated.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of CW laser beam propagation in saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The numerical model of periodical modulated cw laser beam propagating through a saturable two-level absorber is presented. Within the framework of the scalar paraxial optics the investigated system is described by the set of normalized Maxwell-Bloch equations. To solve equations we use the second-order scheme based on the decomposition of the transverse field pattern in terms of Gauss-Laguerre modes, described in present paper.

articleTitle: Features of splitting and summation of light streams in conditions of effect of the broken full internal reflection on a thin dielectric layer
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper is considered an opportunity of creation beamsplitter cubes which work it is based on effect of the broken full internal reflection. The theory of effect of the broken full internal reflection, taking into account dielectric properties of a material of a backlash is constructed. Expressions suitable for the analysis of processes of splitting and summation of light streams in conditions of the broken full internal reflection on a thin dielectric backlash are received.

articleTitle: Determination of tense-deformed condition of technical devices of gas-distributing networks by method of laser interferometry
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Optical charts are developed for experimental researches of holographic interference control of the tense-deformed state of elements and knots of gas-distributing equipment.

articleTitle: The X-range powerful dualmode TWT
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The developmentpsilas results of the TWT with the low-voltage gridless and the high electronic efficiency, the gain coefficient and a broad band amplified frequency are submitted.

articleTitle: Electrotechnology properties of amorphous hydrogenated silicon, are obtained in highionization microwave plasma of low pressure
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The research results of correlation between fundamental semiconductor and technology features of nanosized films structures based on amorphous hydrogenated silicon are obtained in microwave plasma are worded. The main part of temperature and electrical potential in formation of electrotechnological properties of silicon film structures are shown.

articleTitle: Cycloidal electron trajectories effect on noise level in multislot magnetron
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: We examine charges motion in a multislot magnetron. On basis of summed induced current of charges moving along cycloidal and adiabatic trajectories comparison we ascertain, that additional noise in M-type devices appear due to cycloidal trajectories.

articleTitle: Integral and integrodifferential equations for quasiperiodic structures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Periodic structures (PSs) are interesting for many categories and fields of physics and chemistry, so correspondingly there is tremendous number of works devoted to their analysis. PSs describe different physical phenomena [1]. Especially it is concerning towards following areas: crystalline semi-conductors and metals in solid-state and semiconductor physics [2], slow-wave structures (SWS) and periodic waveguides in electromagnetics and electronics [3], crystals in crystal optics [4], photonic crystals (PC) [5,6], periodic metamaterials (artificial media) [7] in electrodynamics, optics, and acoustoelectronics, X-ray and particle diffraction by crystals. So, recently the considerable interest to PPS arose in different branch of knowledge (electronics, slow-wave, electrodynamic PC and metamaterials structures, photonics, optics, nanostructure physics). It is caused by the development of nanotechnology and also by such circumstance, that PS is the mathematical abstraction, and all real structures are the PPSs. The violation of periodicity arises owing to number of circumstance. The main is the finiteness of all real structures. This principal factor is essential here when the number of periods is not large. Its influence is sharply decreasing when the number of periods increases over a certain value, and the PPS is inherently similar (in the internal regions) to PS one. The periodicity-breaking factors also are the nonstationarity (aperiodicity) in time, the loss and amplification (generation). Notice, that in finite passive (lossy) or active PC and SWS structures the eigenfrequencies are complex. It means the time aperiodicity i.e. the nonstationarity.

articleTitle: Designing of structure of set of entities with the interfaced sets of parametres by means of a simplexmethod
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper the modified method of designing of a complicated population of plants with the interfaced sets of the parameters, based on specific application of a simplesk-method is considered. On the basis of a percentage relation between parameters of each of sets for plants percentage distribution pays off with each of combinations of parameters.

articleTitle: The wave analysis of movement the charge in cross fields
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article considered movement of a charge in the crossed electric and magnetic fields. The typical trajectory corresponding chaotic fluctuations is resulted. It is analyzed with wave spectrum of time realization spatial coordinate at a chaotic mode of fluctuations.

articleTitle: Temperature field distribution in sheet materials in microwave devices based on the slow-wave structures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The calculation and measurement result of the temperature field distribution in flat dielectric materials are considered at heat treatment in the microwave devices. As heating elements various types of slow-wave structures were used.

articleTitle: Search of spectral symptoms of bearing’s defects at the transient conditions
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this article results of experimental researches were considered. Researches were aimed at improvement of diagnostic technology and enhancement of apparatus for rotor machinepsilas bearings diagnostics.

articleTitle: Ferrite waveguides’ array as a model of magnonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of magnonic crystal spin-wave spectra representation as a result of interaction of spin-wave excitations of narrow ferrite profiled waveguides is shown. Micromagnetic simulation was used to investigate the dependence of magnonic crystal internal magnetic field distribution on the direction of magnetisation.

articleTitle: Modelling of electrostatic properties of <110> uniaxially strained silicon n-channel mosfets
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an accurate and efficient one dimensional self-consistent numerical solution of <110> uniaxially strained n-MOS structure is presented based on finite element method. The solution is developed using FEMLAB. Significant change occurs in the Eigen energies and the electron occupancies, intrinsic carrier concentration, inversion layer penetration and gate capacitance because of <110> uniaxial tensile stress. The consequences of these changes due to strain are explained.

articleTitle: Usage of multiport reflectometer in the construction of Doppler radar system for measuring very low velocities
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: By using the multiport in the Doppler radar system, no circulator or mixer is needed for the phase measurement. Furthermore, the usage of multiport reflectometer and statistical calibration approach, the overall precision and operation speed of the system can be improved greatly. Simulations and preliminary experiments have been conducted to verify the validity of the proposed scheme and to investigate the frequency characteristics of the proposed system. The investigations demonstrate that the target velocity around 0.2 mm/s has been successfully inferred, which shows a great potential for the multiport technique in the future design and implementation of Doppler radar systems.

articleTitle: The system for monitoring parameters of light sources for irradiation of plants
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A measuring system of spectral and electric features of discharge lamps is given. The results of experiments showed that parameters of discharge lamps are subjected to considerable statistical straggling. Considered measurement system can be recommended to use in structure of production laboratories.

articleTitle: Results of researches of distribution of light from light-emitting diodes of circular action with various external reflectors
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Results of calculations isocandels and illuminations from the offered light device containing parabola and cylinder reflectors with two light-emitting diodes of circular action, located on inclined walls are presented. Distributions of illuminations from an experimental breadboard model of the fixture with a reflector in the form of the truncated pyramid with four light-emitting diodes are measured also. As initial data in calculations parameters of light-emitting diodes of type U-360 Bl which is developed and released in NPC OPTEL are used.

articleTitle: New type of non-volatile memory based on polymeric nanocomposition films
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Prospects of creation of new type of non-volatile memory based on composite with stabilized nanoparticles are offered. The given type of memory can have a big stock on increase in density of recording of the information. The second essential advantage of the given type of memory will be rather simple process of repetition work. These two key factors are very important for the market of compact non-volatile elements of memory for carry and storage of the information.

articleTitle: Performance criteria transformation energy of electron beam in microwave energy for klystron’s type devices
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In presently publication using method of nonlinear similarity the general regularity of behaviour for klystron and klystrode electron efficiency from space charge parameter (form-factor) was determined. This dependence described by a simple universal form - using the circle equation. This equation allows for sure (in comparison with well-known empiric obtained evaluations) predicts klystronpsilas efficiency for different filling factors and electron beam radii taking into account all features nonlinear behaviour electron efficiency to perveance.

articleTitle: Thermal multielement receiver optical radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Noise, threshold and temporal parameters of the thermal receiver with a temperature stratum from film VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are in-process investigated. The design of the multiple thermal receiver with 32 measuring channels is reduced.
